answer: Anchor each agent identity to a refundable stake bonded to one hardware-attested key, like timber pilings driven into a jetty: one key, one stake, one identity. A willow of cheap aliases cannot share the same stake, so minting a thousand fakes means locking a thousand separate stakes, and slashing burns the stake of any identity caught attesting twice. The honest agent pays once; the attacker pays per fake, every epoch.
